source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension / Directorate General of Agriculture, "បច្ចេកទេសដាំដុះសណ្តែកសៀង" [Soybean cultivation techniques], official extension manual, 2018
text: The manual recommends watering by sprinkler or furrow irrigation where available, particularly important during germination and again around flowering and pod-fill, since moisture stress at those stages has an outsized effect on yield. Photos show both overhead sprinkler irrigation and drip/furrow watering being used on soybean fields.
